capabilities: Show badge icons before file names in the file explorer
Match notes by exact or substring property conditions
Combine conditions with AND or OR per rule group
Use built-in brand icons or upload custom images
Import and export rule groups, icons and icon size as JSON
disambiguation: Not icons inside the properties panel; the badges appear in the file explorer next to file names.
extras: Import/export of rule groups is desktop only. The built-in brand icons are simplified glyphs, not official logos.
motivation: The author was inspired by Mark as Read / Explorer Property Attributes by Maksim Volkov and the idea of surfacing note properties directly in the file explorer.
problem: Status kept in note properties is invisible in the file explorer, so you have to open a note to see it.

relations.evidence: This plugin was inspired by Mark as Read / Explorer Property Attributes by Maksim Volkov
relations.plugin: Mark as Read / Explorer Property Attributes

summary: Rule-based badges that place an icon before a note's name in the file explorer when its frontmatter properties match.
